dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: A taste of the north — who wants to try?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Oh my... That fragrance... Hehe, it reminds me of an old friend. Come, don't stand so far away. Sit down and have a cup of hot tea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any recommendations?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Hehe, here's the menu. Please, take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: I'm just an ordinary restaurant owner, nothing special.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Anyway, would you like to try some of our chef's cooking? Since you're in Dornman Port, you really should try out the local specialties.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's that "old friend", if I may ask?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Hehe... I suppose you could call her a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: It was a long time ago. Back then, I was still young, doing some... less-than-honorable business in Nod-Krai. I was the leader of a group of desperate souls, you might say.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: We had a good run for a few years, until I crossed paths with a Treasure Hoarder named Katya.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: She was about my age, claiming to "put an end to my evil deeds" out of nothing but hot-blooded passion... She beat me seven or eight times, but never once took my life.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: She told me that living outside the law couldn't last forever. If I stayed on this path, sooner or later, someone would take my life... if not her, then someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: She was right. So... I gave all my wealth to the kids in the Conch Gang and set out for an adventure at sea.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: The rest of the story is nothing to speak of. I wonder if that woman is even still alive...

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Heh, that perfume of yours certainly brought back memories of her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Lohikeitto... I wonder what it tastes like...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lohikeitto?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Are you a traveler? Forgive me for asking, but do you know how to cook Nod-Krai dishes?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Then could I trouble you to make a Lohikeitto? A guest specifically requested it today. Said they wanted to reminisce on the taste of the "past."

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: But I... I'm starting to forget what that "past" tasted like. Would you help me? I promise the reward will be worth your while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: I see... Guess I'll have to figure something out myself...

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I'm counting on you. Is the Lohikeitto ready?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I'm counting on you. Is the Lohikeitto ready?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: This aroma, and the color too... it really takes me back. I'll deliver it to the guest at once.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: #With this as a reference, I shouldn't need to trouble you again next time. Thank you so much, {NICKNAME}.
